findings.description: The candidate commit 34257f3ef95e7a1bf29031417e7f6d33f708f06a on authoritative base e4d7a2b5709caa18a94f5256d03a0302364b8235 (composed tree f529a1924885019aa884bc6447f8d47fff47526f) touches exactly five test-only paths under crates/mori/tests/: four new fixtures (capped-remittance.mori, capped-remittance.scenario.json, capped-tight.source6, capped-loose.source6) and crates/mori/tests/source6_expand.rs. No production library or CLI code is modified. FORMATTING.diff is empty (0 bytes) and rustfmtChanged is false, confirming root-formatted test bytes equal original candidate bytes. All 511 tracked files in actual-check/SOURCE-PINS.json match pre- and post-execution hashes.

Static inspection of actual-source/crates/mori-checker and actual-source/crates/mori-source6 confirms exact alignment with the candidate fixtures. In mori-checker/src/eval.rs, unitPrice (0.75 USD at scale 2) normalizes to 75 atoms; quoted = unitPrice * itemCount (75 * 3) evaluates via checked u128 multiplication to 225 atoms (Qty<USD>); tightLimit (2.10 USD) and looseLimit (2.50 USD) normalize to 210 and 250 atoms; noCharge = atoms(asset: USD, value: 0) normalizes to 0 atoms. The built-in min(a:, b:) call checks same_numeric_kind (both Qty<USD>) and evaluates amount(a) <= amount(b): for tightAmount, min(225, 210) selects operand b = 210 atoms; for looseAmount, min(225, 250) selects operand a = 225 atoms. Both TightPayment and LoosePayment intents satisfy check_s0_intent (all values <= S0_MAX = 2^127 - 1) and produce Support::LocalS0 on actions pay_tight and pay_loose. In mori-source6/src/transfer.rs, validate_scenario enforces exact scenario bindings (domain Midnight, asset A, allowance owner Owner, and three ordered balance accounts [Owner, Recipient, Fee] with amounts [1000, 5, 7]), and emit guards the fee credit effect behind 'if t.fee > 0'. Because fee == 0, the fee credit line is omitted while the Fee balance cell (balance Fee 7;) remains in the authenticated opening block, producing the five ordered effects: debit Owner <210|225>; credit Recipient <210|225>; use_allowance Owner <210|225>; use_replay "nC"; advance_head "c0" "c1"; followed by post_head "c1";.

The pre-execution independent oracle (FREEZE.sha256 digest 4a859749e91cc31cce74a1e9220e91235c9263a50e5dee1d84949e158885ba79 over 23 verified members, frozen at 2026-10-18T11:43:30.468747+00:00 prior to CHECK-PLAN.json at 11:44:22.088575+00:00 and test execution at 11:44:22.093292+00:00) independently derived identical normalized values (75, 3, 225, 210, 250, tightAmount=210 via branch b, looseAmount=225 via branch a, noCharge=0), identical Source6 AST structures, identical three opening balance cells (Owner 1000, Recipient 5, Fee 7), and identical five ordered effect statements (omitting credit Fee when fee == 0) in EXPECTED-SEMANTICS.json, pay_*.ordered-target-lines.expected.json, and pay_*.source6.ast.expected.json. The only difference between pay_*.independent-source6.txt and candidate/crates/mori/tests/fixtures/source6-expansion/capped-*.source6 is non-semantic whitespace formatting (2-space block indentation and 'valid 2 .. 20;' in the oracle's EBNF-valid presentation vs. unindented lines and 'valid 2..20;' in transfer.rs stdout and the hand-authored candidate fixtures). Both presentations tokenize identically under financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts. PROVENANCE.json transparently discloses that the oracle author had prior session exposure to Source6 transfer expansion rules, so the oracle serves as an independent pre-execution arithmetic and statement-order derivation rather than a clean-room wire-format golden.

The captured execution in actual-check/public-quantity-min ran 'cargo test --manifest-path .../crates/mori/Cargo.toml --frozen -j1 -p mori --no-default-features --features source6-expansion --test source6_expand -- quantity_min_selects_both_operands_through_public_source6_expansion --exact --test-threads=1' and exited 0 in 53.494262769 seconds (1 passed, 0 failed, 7 filtered out). Within that single test, three public CLI invocations succeeded: (1) 'mori check <capped.mori> --json' verified valid == true, agreement == CappedRemittance, and both TightPayment/LoosePayment and pay_tight/pay_loose carrying status == 'local-s0'; (2) 'mori --quiet expand <capped.mori> --action pay_tight --scenario <capped.json> --emit-source6-transfer' matched capped-tight.source6 byte-for-byte on stdout with empty stderr; and (3) 'mori --quiet expand <capped.mori> --action pay_loose --scenario <capped.json> --emit-source6-transfer' matched capped-loose.source6 byte-for-byte on stdout with empty stderr. Temporary directory /tmp/moriarty-source6-min-check-b25a54d2_da2 was removed (existsAfter: false) and isolated process session 661909 left no surviving processes.

While actual-source/experiments/moriarty-language/src/successor/financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts and mil4-s0-core-v5.ts were statically inspected—confirming that parseAndLowerSource6 on capped-tight.source6 and capped-loose.source6 would construct the expected Source6Ast and Core5 replay key ['Midnight','Owner','nC'] and that prepareMil4S0 would return PreparedUnqualified—neither the TypeScript parser/lowerer nor the Core5 preparer was executed for pay_tight or pay_loose. Additionally, REVIEW-SCOPE.md explicitly notes 'crates/mori/src/commands/source.rs' as physically missing from the packet (not read), and four CLI helper files pinned in SOURCE-PINS.json (crates/mori/src/json.rs, crates/mori/src/commands/core_io.rs, crates/mori/src/display.rs, crates/mori/src/error.rs) are not physically bundled under actual-source/crates/mori/src/ (not read).
